description: Today's date and weight unit for this person, today's food against their targets, their last few workouts, their routines, notes they left, and what they changed in the app since the assistant's last change (sets done differently from a plan show the planned values beside them). Each planned workout says whether it is reviewed: the app shows "Reviewed by" if the assistant wrote the plan after the person's latest workout. suggestedNext is the app's own pick from their rotation when nothing is planned today. Read-only.
